get.summary: Which login door is open: the operator password or Cloudflare Access.

post.summary: Log in with the operator password; sets the session cookie.

204.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set.

post.summary: End this browser session. Session only.

204.description: Logged out; the session cookie is cleared.

get.summary: List every API key, newest first, without the key itself. Session only.

post.summary: Create an API key. The answer carries the key itself this once. Session only.

201.description: The created key, with the key itself.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key; it stops working on the next request. Session only.

post.summary: Create a link, with a custom slug or a generated one. The destination's host is screened (422 destination_flagged); a session may send screening: "skip" to save it anyway.

get.summary: List links, newest first (createdAt desc, slug desc), cursor-paginated.

patch.summary: Edit a link as a merge-patch: destination, title (null clears it), enabled. An empty {} still rewrites the redirect cache entry. A destination is screened like on creation. campaign: null detaches the link; campaign: {id} adopts a plain link whose destination already matches the campaign (409 adopt_mismatch with the reason code, campaign_member, campaign_link_limit).

delete.summary: Delete a link for good; its slug becomes free.

post.summary: Create a campaign. utmCampaign defaults to the trimmed name. The base URL follows the destination rules, must carry no utm_* parameter (base_url_has_utm) and is screened (422 destination_flagged); a session may send screening: "skip". 409 campaign_name_taken when another campaign has the name, ignoring case.

get.summary: List campaigns, newest first (createdAt desc, id desc), cursor-paginated; q matches the name and the UTM campaign. The aggregates are computed from the links.

schema.description: Plain substring of the name or the UTM campaign.

patch.summary: Edit a campaign as a merge-patch: name. The aggregates are read-only. 409 campaign_name_taken when another campaign has the name, ignoring case.

delete.summary: Delete a campaign. Its links are detached, never deleted or disabled.

204.description: Deleted; its links are plain links now.

get.summary: Every link of the campaign, oldest first (createdAt asc, slug asc), unpaginated.

post.summary: Create links in the campaign, all or nothing; the only way to create a campaign link. Each destination is composed from the campaign and the item's utm. Every failing item is reported in one 400 validation_failed (slug_taken, utm_combination_taken with conflictsWith, destination_invalid); 409 campaign_link_limit past 50 links; the base URL's host is screened once (422 destination_flagged).

201.description: The created links, in request order.

get.summary: The instance settings: the root destination, Access mode and read-only instance facts.

patch.summary: Edit the settings as a merge-patch. rootDestination: null unsets it. analyticsConfigured and version are read-only. An empty {} still rewrites the root destination's redirect cache entry. A rootDestination is screened like a link's destination. access is session only: turning Access mode on is refused on a workers.dev host (access_requires_own_domain) and when the team's public keys cannot be fetched (access_unreachable); access: null turns it off from any host.

post.summary: Change the operator password after re-entering the current one; ends every session. Session only.

204.description: Changed; every session is ended and this one's cookie cleared.

get.summary: A link's click breakdowns for the range: series (hourly for 24h, daily otherwise, zero-filled), top 10 countries, top 10 referrer hosts and device classes. Last 90 days, estimated. 503 analytics_unavailable when breakdowns are not configured, naming what is missing.

schema.description: The IANA time zone that day and hour boundaries follow, usually the browser's.

get.summary: The instance overview: clicks today, in the last 7 and 30 days, the top 10 links for the range and a series per link with a click in the range. Last 90 days, estimated. 503 analytics_unavailable when breakdowns are not configured.

schema.description: The IANA time zone that day and hour boundaries follow, usually the browser's.

term.description: utm_term; empty or null for none.

title.description: Trimmed, at most 200 characters; empty or null means no title.

screening.description: "skip" saves a destination screening flagged (destination_flagged); from a session only, never stored.

name.description: Trimmed, 1 to 100 characters, unique across the instance ignoring case (campaign_name_taken).

utmId.description: The optional utm_id every link carries; empty or null for none.

screening.description: "skip" saves a destination screening flagged (destination_flagged); from a session only, never stored.

clickCount.description: Never accepted: clickCount is computed from the links (read_only_field).

syncPendingLinkCount.description: Never accepted: syncPendingLinkCount is computed from the links (read_only_field).

campaign.description: null detaches the link from its campaign, keeping its destination. {id} adopts a plain link into the campaign when its destination already matches it (ignoring UTM order and encoding), rewriting it to the canonical form.

slug.description: Never accepted: a link's slug cannot be changed (slug_immutable).

anyOf.description: An absolute http or https URL, at most 2048 characters of printable ASCII (percent-encoded), not pointing at this instance.

access.description: Turns Cloudflare Access mode on (session only, own domain only, the team's public keys must be reachable); null turns it off.

aud.description: The Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application that guards /admin and /api.
